posts.body: Predictions: 0 of 15 Winners, 0 Perfect, 0 Points | Tied for 1st with 133 others Park vs. NorovEoh Jin Park, TKO, R1we will see if park’s confidence is shot; he’s going against a huge jobber that got colded by a debutant in one minute. Nice to see him get back in there though.Son vs. KelemetovIsmail Kelemetov, SUB, R1Kelemetov has a very padded record so it wouldn’t be a shock to see him get checked here. Son has only lost to decent people or good prospects but has never really fought a grappler so ill lean the dagestaniPark vs. KazbekovAydemir Kazbekov, DECAgain with the fraud Russians on this card man. Park is so fun to watch but he really is a typical Korean brawler that has no tdd.Pereira vs. JiHyuk Min Ji, TKO, R2Now this will be FOTN for sure. Hyuk Min Ji is one of my favorite Korean prospects who is going up against a fighter similar to his style. I think Ji will catch him coming in and shut his lights off (slight bias)

posts.author: AyyLmaonnaise
posts.body: Predictions: 0 of 15 Winners, 0 Perfect, 0 Points | Tied for 1st with 133 others Park vs. NorovEoh Jin Park, SUB, R1This should be an easy bounce back for Park. He got smoked on RTU but I still think he could be decent. His striking defense is bad but he’s big for the division, has good striking, and decent grappling. He was telegraphing his shots on RTU but I think he had a bit of nerves as well. This other guy seems powerful but he looks low levelPereira vs. JiHyuk Min Ji, TKO, R2This is a sick fight, pereira will be a really good test for Ji. Ji’s striking is very dangerous and he’s beaten some really good guys despite his inexperience. He seems like he might have what it takes to get to the next level

posts.author: Robwett
posts.body: Predictions: 0 of 15 Winners, 0 Perfect, 0 Points | Tied for 1st with 133 others Park vs. NorovEoh Jin Park, TKO, R1Park was unlucky to draw Nakamura for his first RTU fight. He's got the advantage that he's very big and rangey for the division but like a lot of taller guys he has poor striking defense and keeps his chin in the air. This is good match up for him so let's hope getting colded badly by Nakamura didn't ruin his confidence too muchPereira vs. JiHyuk Min Ji, TKO, R1Ji is my favorite prospect out of Korea, he's got nukes in his hands. His win over Takeda has aged well so he has shown the ability to beat (and finish) higher level guys. Pereira is also pretty good and dangerous so he has the be carful but I think he should be able to win this. Let him build some experience in Black Combat or RIZIN and then put him on DWCS or RTU * Edited at 04.24.2026, 6:13 AM ET *
